title: Chick dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#3a5a7a'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M42 74 L36 86' stroke='#ffb020' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 74 L66 84' stroke='#ffb020' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 86 L30 88 M36 86 L38 90' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 84 L72 88 M66 84 L64 90' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- left wing raised -->
  <path d='M30 52 Q18 40 22 30' stroke='#ffd93b' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- right wing out -->
  <path d='M70 54 Q82 48 86 40' stroke='#ffd93b' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='17' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='12' fill='#ffe98a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- little dance tuft -->
  <path d='M50 15 Q46 8 52 6 Q56 10 54 16' fill='#ffb020'/>
  <!-- eyes happy -->
  <path d='M42 30 Q45 26 48 30' stroke='#5a3a00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 30 Q57 26 60 30' stroke='#5a3a00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- beak open singing -->
  <path d='M46 38 L50 44 L54 38 Z' fill='#ff8a1f'/>
  <path d='M46 41 L54 41' stroke='#c85a00' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='3' fill='#7ad0ff'/>
  <path d='M27 24 L27 14' stroke='#7ad0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ff9be0'/>
  <path d='M81 22 L81 12' stroke='#ff9be0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 12 Q78 10 84 12' stroke='#ff9be0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
</svg>
